purpose: Independent mathematical error evidence for the implemented engine; complements rather than reruns unit and streamline tests.
comparisonRule: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference); no rounding before comparison

report.method: Normalized classical RK4; adaptive two-half-step acceptance with Richardson estimate /15

limitations: Additional curated fields do not certify arbitrary expressions or scales.
Unit-suite counts are intentionally left to the linked test report.
This script does not regenerate streamline or browser evidence.
